checks.text: With no events, the page shows the heading "Event Countdown", the text "No events yet", and the tab labels "Upcoming" and "Past".

Typing "Birthday" in the field labelled "Event name", selecting "2025-12-25" in the date picker labelled "Date", typing "18:00" in the time input labelled "Time", and clicking the button "Add event" adds a list item containing "Birthday" and the text "in 1d 0h 0m 0s" (assuming current time is 2025-12-24 18:00:00 local).
After adding the event "Birthday" on 2025-12-25 18:00, the list item for "Birthday" contains the text "in 1d 0h 0m 0s".
Clicking the button "Delete Birthday" removes the list item for "Birthday" and the page shows the text "No events yet".
Adding an event "Meeting" with date "2025-12-20" and time "09:00" (a past date relative to 2025-12-24 18:00:00) adds a list item containing "Meeting" and the text "passed 4d 9h 0m 0s ago".
Clicking the tab "Past" shows the list item for "Meeting" with the text "passed 4d 9h 0m 0s ago" and hides the list item for "Birthday".
Clicking the tab "Upcoming" shows the list item for "Birthday" with the text "in 1d 0h 0m 0s" and hides the list item for "Meeting".

Typing "1h 20m" in the field labelled "Quick add duration" and clicking the button "Add quick event" adds a list item containing "Quick event" and the text "in 1h 20m 0s" (assuming current time is 2025-12-24 18:00:00 local).
Reload keeps the event "Birthday" with the list item containing "Birthday" and the text "in 1d 0h 0m 0s".
